name: Transport + CloudEvents envelope
description: Transport abstraction (DD-69 pattern): NATSTransport + InMemoryTransport. CloudEvents v1.0 envelope with mf* extensions (DD-68). NATS accounts creds at ~/.config/nats/creds/reflex.creds (DD-72). bun test runs without live NATS.

name: Config loader + schema + hot-reload
description: metafactory/activation/v1 zod schema. Load reflex.yaml sidecars from configured roots + ~/.config/reflex/activations/*.yaml, merged; duplicate blueprint id = load error. File watcher hot-reloads blueprint set atomically; Matched Decisions for removed blueprints expire with reason blueprint-removed. reflex validate works daemon-less. One config entry = one Activation Blueprint with a when: block (impulse kinds: schedule|manual|bus|http).

name: SQLite storage (Drizzle)
description: Tables: decisions (immutable rows, six outcomes), approvals (matched/approved/denied/expired lifecycle), guard_state (cooldowns, run locks, buffered impulses, idempotency keys), fired_events. ~/.local/state/reflex/reflex.db. Ignored decisions as per-blueprint counters. See ADR-0001 (no UPDATE path for decision outcomes).

name: Decision pipeline core
description: Impulse -> rule evaluation -> Activation Decision (ignored/matched/blocked/fired/denied/expired) -> policy (auto/approval/disabled) -> guards (cooldown, run lock skip|buffer, idempotency key) -> Activation Event on mf.{net}.reflex.activation.fired.{target}. Decision audit events on mf.{net}.reflex.activation.decision.{outcome}. Dry Run produces Dry Run Verdict: no guard mutation, no events, not in history. Buffered Impulse re-presented as fresh decision, all guards re-run.

name: Schedule impulse source (cron)
description: Internal impulse source: cron expressions with timezone (croner). Drives schedule-kind blueprints.

name: Manual fire + approval flow
description: reflex fire <blueprint-id> --input json produces a manual impulse through the full pipeline (no bypass). Approval lifecycle: Matched Decisions wait; reflex approve/deny <decision-id>; per-blueprint approval_timeout (default 1h) resolves to Expired Decision; deny produces Denied Decision.

name: CLI over NATS request/reply
description: reflex status/list/fire/approve/deny/pending/history/test/validate. Daemon serves mf.{net}.reflex.cmd.> request/reply; CLI is a thin NATS client. Cortex can issue identical commands later.

name: Bus impulse source (subscription + matcher)
description: Per-blueprint NATS subject subscriptions; match = subject pattern + flat field-equals conditions on CloudEvents data. No expression language in v0. Also consumes mf.{net}.pulse.run.> outcomes for Run Lock release and Buffered Impulse re-presentation.

name: Minimal http impulse source
description: Localhost HTTP endpoint auto-generated per http-kind blueprint (POST /hook/{blueprint-id}), bearer-token auth only. External impulse source. Windmill pattern, deliberately minimal.

name: Example activation blueprints
description: Three committed examples: F_PR_STATS daily schedule, Pilot 30-min scan (bus + approval), F_TESTING manual impulse. Living docs and integration-test fixtures.
